draft.heroMessage: Matching People With Homes Across Generations in Roanoke
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome! I’m here to guide buyers, sellers, and investors through every step of your next Roanoke Valley real estate journey, combining local knowledge with decades of trusted experience.
draft.aboutParagraph: As the founder of Rocky’s Mom Realty and a lifelong Roanoke resident, my mission is simple: support every client with honest communication, deep community knowledge, and care that lasts long after the closing. From first-time buyers to invested sellers and those looking to move up or downsize, I bring 20+ years in local real estate and generations of client relationships to your side. Let’s talk about your goals and build your next chapter together.
draft.conciergeLine: Have a question about a listing or need local advice? Call or email anytime—I’m here to help.
draft.contactLine: Ready to take the next step? Contact me at (540) 400-5980 or homes@rockysmom.com.
